blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. highlighted the decades-long trust between ASEAN and Japan, while Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi called for stronger regional resilience amid growing instability, as the leaders opened the 29th ASEAN-Japan Summit on Monday.
